prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Controls Sandbox: Redesign home_intro into an interactive desktop pet control sandbox where users practice hiding, moving, and chatting with their pet before completing onboarding. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Live Preview & Retry Studio: Add a new screen new_pet_preview right after photo upload to give instant visual feedback and retry options before issuing the adoption certificate. (why: Support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption median time is 89s.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Delayed Sign-In Reorder: Move sign_in screen to after the adoption certificate stage so users bond with their pet before committing their account details. (why: sign_in loses 27.1% of users right at the beginning; postponing sign-in builds ownership before requiring account creation.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Visual Path Selection Storybook Flow: Add a new interactive storybook screen new_path_intro before path selection to clearly showcase preset vs custom pet experiences. (why: choose_path drops 23.8% of users with an extreme mean time of 514s, indicating confusion about path options.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync Account Verification Warning: Add an explicit hint and account verification indicator on the sign-in screen to prevent logging into wrong or duplicate accounts. (why: 8 support emails (the largest complaint category) reported pets missing or account progress reset after signing in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Renderer Health Check & Progress Timer: Add real-time rendering status updates and display permission reminders on the waiting screen while the pet renders. (why: Home step median wait is 201s (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop or app failing to open.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Hotkey & Control Quick Reference: Update home_intro text to explicitly teach hotkeys for hiding, showing, and calling the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets cited post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
7: [adoption, layout] Pet Creation Guidelines Split Layout: Change upload_photos layout to split view featuring photo quality checklists and formatting tips alongside the picker. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, and adoption stage conversion is 68.7%.)
8: [choose_path, incentive] Adoption Perk Badge Selection Banner: Add adoption speed badges and clear time estimates to path options on the choose_path screen. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514 seconds; setting clear time expectations speeds up decision-making.)
9: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Notification Toggle: Add a desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during generation. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to switch context or abandon the window.)

scores.note: Finish loses 35.2% of users and has 3 support emails; building an interactive desktop sandbox requires new release build.

Addresses the largest complaint volume (8 emails) and 27.1% drop with a low-cost UI hint and verification indicator.
Home step has high wait time (median 201s) and render errors; adding status updates improves clarity during long renders.
Copy update for finish step addressing 3 support tickets; very cheap to execute with modest expected lift.
Adoption step drops 31.3%; adding formatting guidelines directly alongside the photo picker reduces generation failures.
Config/UI change on choose_path to reduce decision paralysis caused by long mean time (514s).
Helps retention during the 201s median wait on home step by allowing users to safely minimize the application.
